en.title: LectureLens
en.heading: Keep the lesson. Find what matters.
en.intro: Test window capture and sound before building the study-notes pipeline.
en.local: On this device · no cloud services
en.notice: Use a dedicated browser window for the class. Changing tabs changes the recorded content. System audio includes other apps and notifications. Preview also accesses the window and sound; it is not saved until you start recording.
en.consent: I have permission to capture this lesson and understand that other system sounds may be included.
en.paused: Paused — new media is not saved
en.saved: Saved locally. PDF generation is not implemented in this spike.
en.signal: Play class audio to unlock recording. A track alone does not prove sound works.
en.silent: No recent sound signal. Check class playback and Windows sound output.
en.disk: Estimated space for two hours / free space
en.embeddedNotice: Manual compatibility experiment. Opening this window contacts your platform. Sign-in and isolated sound are unverified. No microphone or webcam access in this spike.
en.privacy: Raw recordings stay local until you delete them. This spike has no PDF step yet; automatic deletion after a successful PDF belongs to the next slice.
en.sourceChanged: Window title changed. Check that the class is still selected.
en.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this session's raw recording?
en.exported: Recording reconstructed in its session folder.
en.failed: Recording stopped with an error. Saved chunks remain local; check recovery.
en.signalDetected: Sound signal detected. Confirm that it belongs to the class.
